name: William Durant
source: The well-bred Will has come to Los Angeles for the films, the culture, the weather, and, of course, the jazz. After leading a tightly prescribed life as a firstborn English aristocrat, Will desperately seeks the freedom he has been denied. Will you accept your fates or rebel against them together?
